name: Dr Fiona

intro.text: The castle has a bottle dungeon: a pit cut into the rock, narrow at the neck, wide at the bottom. You were lowered in on a rope. There was no other way out. Shall we have a battle about it?

win: History is written by the winners. You can borrow my pen.
after: John Knox was in the castle when it fell in 1547. The French took him away to row in their galleys. He came back to Scotland and changed it.
